remapping.scope: scaled official-slice subnetwork, not native full-model inference
remapping.vision_layers: destination layers reuse official vision layer 0
remapping.text_layers: destination layer modulo 6 == 5 uses official layer 5; others layer 0
remapping.framing: public BOI 255999 uses slice row 0; public EOI 258882 uses slice row 1
remapping.framing_limit: these are explicitly remapped slice embeddings, not official BOI/EOI rows
remapping.ple: destination layer i selects available source rows i*scaled_PLE_DIM + channel
remapping.heads: packed leading source components repartitioned into scaled destination heads
remapping.head_limit: scaled heads are not separate original checkpoint heads
remapping.positions: row axis uses loaded [0,row,channel], column axis loaded [1,col,channel]; under the manifest contiguous range these are original axis 0 positions row and 256+col, not original axis 1
remapping.extraction: manifest ranges interpreted as contiguous prefixes of original tensors; original position coordinates recovered with original strides, not reshape

rejected_malformed_cases.rejection: test.weight: overlapping or noncontiguous payload interval
